slots.label: Breakfast
slots.text: Overnight oats with cinnamon, toasted pecans, and a choice of blueberry or blackberry compote that stretches all the way down the serving table for anyone who wants second helpings.

slots.label: Lunch
slots.text: Slow-roasted vegetable lasagne with layers of courgette, aubergine, spinach, and extra garlic béchamel; served with a rocket, fennel, and grapefruit salad dressed in a citrus vinaigrette.

slots.label: Snack
slots.text: Create-your-own yoghurt bar featuring thick Greek yoghurt, toasted coconut shards, almond brittle, mango compote, and caramelised pineapple chunks.

notes: Remember to bring reusable water bottles; infusions are cucumber-mint, lemon-thyme, and raspberry-basil.

slots.label: Breakfast
slots.text: Griddled sourdough with whipped ricotta, roasted cherry tomatoes, balsamic glaze, and a cloud of basil oil for dipping.

slots.label: Lunch
slots.text: Caramelised onion and thyme tart, roasted cauliflower steaks dusted with smoked paprika, and a three-bean salad tossed in a zingy lime, coriander, and jalapeño dressing.

slots.label: Dessert
slots.text: Mini pavlovas stacked high with lemon curd cream, kiwi slices, passionfruit pulp, and shards of crisp meringue.

notes: Cooking club meets after school to prep sauces for the next day; check the ingredients list in the staff room before leaving.

slots.label: Breakfast
slots.text: Stacked buckwheat pancakes layered with sticky date caramel, roasted apples, pecans, and maple syrup infused with orange zest.

slots.label: Lunch
slots.text: Fire-baked jacket potatoes with coriander-lime butter, chipotle chickpea chilli, charred corn niblets, pickled red onions, and an avocado crema to drizzle or dunk.

slots.label: Snack
slots.text: An overflowing grazing board with hummus, muhammara, beetroot tzatziki, sumac-crusted pitta shards, seasonal crudités, and rosemary sea-salt crackers.

notes: Library pop-up lunchtime club today; if the rota runs late, redirect anyone waiting for instruments to the music room by 12:45.

slots.label: Breakfast
slots.text: Coconut chia pudding topped with roasted hazelnuts, poached rhubarb, shaved dark chocolate, and lime zest.

slots.label: Lunch
slots.text: Wholegrain noodle bowls with miso-ginger broth, slow-cooked soy mushrooms, tofu puffs, edamame, shredded greens, quick-pickled carrots, chilli crunch, and crispy shallots.

slots.label: Snack
slots.text: Freshly baked focaccia squares filled with roasted pepper, mozzarella, basil pesto, rocket, and balsamic drizzle.

notes: Drama rehearsals occupy the hall from 15:30; clear down the snack station by 15:15.

slots.label: Breakfast
slots.text: Hearty shakshuka with heritage tomatoes, spiced chickpeas, baked eggs, and warm sourdough wedges alongside honey butter.

slots.label: Lunch
slots.text: Feast platters with slow-cooked harissa jackfruit, zesty couscous with roasted apricots, maple-roasted sprouts, citrus-dressed slaw, and tahini yoghurt.

slots.label: Dessert
slots.text: An endless layered trifle of vanilla sponge, raspberry jam, thick custard, whipped mascarpone, macerated berries, and honeycomb pieces.

notes: Friday celebrations extend into the evening—expect a second wave around 18:30 for the board-games club.

slots.label: Breakfast
slots.text: Granola sundae tower with layers of toasted walnut granola, vanilla yoghurt, roasted cherries, pomegranate arils, and citrus curd.

slots.label: Lunch
slots.text: Cedar-plank roasted salmon (or maple tempeh) with dill yoghurt, crispy smashed potatoes, fennel orange salad, and buttered green beans showered in lemon zest.

slots.label: Snack
slots.text: Warm banana bread slices soaked in espresso maple syrup, whipped mascarpone, and toasted cacao nibs.

notes: STEM club testing today; leave the back corner free for robotics kits and remember to lock up the soldering station.

slots.label: Festival Feast
slots.text: Street-food style stations with falafel wraps, crispy halloumi bites, tahini drizzle, pickled vegetables, vibrant za'atar fries, chimichurri corn ribs, and herbaceous yogurt dips, running from lunchtime through late evening.

slots.label: Sweet Table
slots.text: Towering croquembouche draped in spun sugar, tray after tray of pistachio baklava, flourless chocolate torte with raspberry coulis, and miniature lemon meringue pies.
